    batch_size, seq_len, _ = hidden_states.shape

    if seq_len == 1:
        value_states = F.linear(
            hidden_states,
            v_proj_weight,
            v_proj_bias,
        ).view(batch_size, 1, 8, 128)

        attention_output = (
            value_states.unsqueeze(3)
            .expand(batch_size, 1, 8, 12, 128)
            .reshape(batch_size, 1, 12288)
        )
        return F.linear(attention_output, o_proj_weight, None)

    value_states = F.linear(
        hidden_states,
        v_proj_weight,
        v_proj_bias,
    )

    key_states = F.linear(
        hidden_states,
        k_proj_weight,
        k_proj_bias,
    )
    key_states = _apply_qk_norm_rope(
        key_states,
        k_norm_weight,
        cos,
        sin,
        rms_norm_eps,
        seq_len,
        seq_len,
        0,
        8,
    )

    if seq_len <= 128:
        query_states = F.linear(
            hidden_states[:, 1:, :],
            q_proj_weight,
            q_proj_bias,
        )
        query_states = _apply_qk_norm_rope(
            query_states,
            q_norm_weight,
            cos,
            sin,
            rms_norm_eps,
            seq_len - 1,
            seq_len,
            1,
            96,
        )

        attention_output = torch.empty(
            (batch_size, seq_len, 12288),
            device=hidden_states.device,
            dtype=hidden_states.dtype,
        )

        block_seq = max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(seq_len))

        if seq_len >= 64:
            split = block_seq // 2

            if seq_len == 64:
                _launch_short_attention(
                    query_states,
                    key_states,
                    value_states,
                    attention_output,
                    batch_size,
                    seq_len,
                    0,
                    split,
                    split,
                    num_warps=2,
                    num_stages=1,
                )
                _launch_short_attention(
                    query_states,
                    key_states,
                    value_states,
                    attention_output,
                    batch_size,
                    seq_len,
                    split,
                    seq_len - split,
                    block_seq,
                    num_warps=2,
                    num_stages=1,
                )
            else:
                _launch_short_attention(
                    query_states,
                    key_states,
                    value_states,
                    attention_output,
                    batch_size,
                    seq_len,
                    0,
                    split,
                    split,
                )
                _launch_short_attention(
                    query_states,
                    key_states,
                    value_states,
                    attention_output,
                    batch_size,
                    seq_len,
                    split,
                    seq_len - split,
                    block_seq,
                )
        else:
            _launch_short_attention(
                query_states,
                key_states,
                value_states,
                attention_output,
                batch_size,
                seq_len,
                0,
                seq_len,
                block_seq,
            )
    else:
        query_states = F.linear(
            hidden_states,
            q_proj_weight,
            q_proj_bias,
        )
        query_states = _apply_qk_norm_rope(
            query_states,
            q_norm_weight,
            cos,
            sin,
            rms_norm_eps,
            seq_len,
            seq_len,
            0,
            96,
        )

        query_states = query_states.view(
            batch_size,
            seq_len,
            96,
            128,
        ).transpose(1, 2)
        key_states = key_states.view(
            batch_size,
            seq_len,
            8,
            128,
        ).transpose(1, 2)
        value_states = value_states.view(
            batch_size,
            seq_len,
            8,
            128,
        ).transpose(1, 2)

        attention_output = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
            query_states,
            key_states,
            value_states,
            is_causal=True,
            enable_gqa=True,
        )
        attention_output = (
            attention_output.transpose(1, 2)
            .contiguous()
            .view(batch_size, seq_len, 12288)
        )

    return F.linear(attention_output, o_proj_weight, None)
